First public release of the StatHubs connector for OXID eShop.

## Highlights
- Connect your shop to the StatHubs app by scanning a QR code under **Extensions → StatHubs**.
- Read-only order endpoint protected by credentials generated on your shop. It sends no customer names, email addresses or addresses.
- Deactivating the module turns off StatHubs access immediately.

## Compatibility
- Tested on OXID eShop Community Edition 7.5.2 with PHP 8.3.
- Requires OXID eShop 7.5.x and PHP 8.3 or later.

## Download
- `stathubs-oxid.zip`: the module

## Installation
Installation requires shell access. OXID eShop cannot install modules from a ZIP in the admin. You can activate the module in the admin under Extensions → Modules. Follow the steps in the [README](../../blob/v1.0.0/README.md#installation).
